name: tailscale-pam
description: Connect to infrastructure over Tailscale PAM (SSH, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MS SQL, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, RDP, and more): see what this machine can reach, and request just-in-time access through jitd. Credentials are injected by Tailscale PAM.

jit_url.title: jitd URL
jit_url.description: Where jitd answers on your tailnet. Change it only if jitd doesn't run as the machine named jit, for example http://jit-1 or http://access.
